      - name: Build staging variant into dist/staging
        env:
          VITE_ITEMS_API: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwtdRN75mh4OlKQXM_JQlIRoO7OdB4BxtATgsnD0tnTUT2B02HUewbsd2cecycmUi1f/exec"

          npm run build:staging
          mkdir -p dist/staging
          cp -r dist-staging/* dist/staging/
